words.enDefinition: talk about other people's private lives for fun

examples.en: The girls on my floor love to gossip about who's dating whom.
examples.zh: 我们楼层的女生很喜欢「说闲话」，讨论谁在跟谁交往。

examples.en: We gossiped about the new exchange students over late-night noodles.
examples.zh: 深夜吃泡面时，我们都在「八卦」新来的交换生。

words.enDefinition: talk too proudly about your own achievements

examples.en: He keeps bragging about his internship at the bank, which gets annoying.
examples.zh: 他不停地「吹嘘」自己在银行的实习，听得人有点烦。

examples.en: She bragged that she finished the whole group project in one night.
examples.zh: 她「吹牛」说自己一晚上就做完了整个小组项目。

words.enDefinition: keep asking someone to do something in an annoying way

examples.en: My mom keeps nagging me to call home at least once a week.
examples.zh: 我妈不停地「唠叨」，让我每周至少往家里打个电话。

examples.en: I hate to nag, but the dishes have been sitting there since morning.
examples.zh: 我不想「唠叨」，可这些碗从早上就一直泡在水池里。

words.enDefinition: make fun of someone in a playful or unkind way

examples.en: His roommates tease him about his terrible sense of direction.
examples.zh: 室友们老是「取笑」他方向感差。

examples.en: We teased our friend gently about falling asleep during the movie.
examples.zh: 朋友看电影时睡着了，我们轻轻「打趣」了他一下。

words.enDefinition: say something nice about someone or their work

examples.en: Our professor complimented the whole team on a well-organized presentation.
examples.zh: 教授「称赞」了我们小组，说展示条理清晰。

examples.en: She complimented my cooking, even though the rice was slightly burnt.
examples.zh: 她「夸」我做饭好吃，尽管米饭有点糊。

words.enDefinition: ask several people in order to find something out

examples.en: I'll ask around and see if anyone is subletting a room this summer.
examples.zh: 我会去「四处打听」，看看今年夏天有没有人转租房间。

examples.en: Ask around the department—someone probably has a spare bike pump.
examples.zh: 在系里「到处问问」，多半有人有多余的打气筒。

words.enDefinition: stop paying attention because you are bored or tired

examples.en: I zoned out halfway through the statistics lecture and missed the deadline announcement.
examples.zh: 统计学课听到一半我就「走神」了，错过了截止日期的通知。

examples.en: Sorry, I zoned out for a second—could you repeat the room number?
examples.zh: 抱歉，我刚才「走神」了，能再说一遍房间号吗？

words.enDefinition: meet someone you know by pure chance

examples.en: I bumped into my high-school classmate at the campus coffee shop yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我在校园咖啡店「偶遇」了高中同学。

examples.en: You'll probably bump into her at the gym—she goes every evening.
examples.zh: 你在健身房很可能会「碰见」她，她每天晚上都去。

words.enDefinition: stay level with something moving or changing fast

examples.en: The lectures move fast, so review weekly or you won't keep up.
examples.zh: 课讲得很快，每周都要复习，不然会「跟不上」。

examples.en: She walks so quickly that I can hardly keep up with her.
examples.zh: 她走得太快了，我几乎「跟不上」她。

words.enDefinition: join someone in what they are about to do

examples.en: We're heading to the farmers' market on Saturday, so feel free to come along.
examples.zh: 我们周六要去农贸市场，欢迎你「一起来」。

examples.en: My roommate came along to the library even though she had nothing to read.
examples.zh: 室友虽然没书要看，还是「跟着」一起去了图书馆。

collocations: asked if I could come along

words.enDefinition: visit a place or person briefly on your way

examples.en: I'll stop by the post office after class to mail this package.
examples.zh: 下课后我会「顺路去趟」邮局寄这个包裹。

examples.en: Stop by my office anytime if the schedule still confuses you.
examples.zh: 如果课表还是让你犯迷糊，随时「来」我办公室坐坐。

words.enDefinition: accidentally sleep longer than you intended

examples.en: I overslept and missed the free shuttle to the airport.
examples.zh: 我「睡过头」了，错过了去机场的免费班车。

examples.en: Set two alarms in winter—it's easy to oversleep in a warm room.
examples.zh: 冬天设两个闹钟吧，屋里一暖就容易「睡过头」。

words.enDefinition: sleep for a short time during the day

examples.en: I usually nap for twenty minutes after lunch to survive afternoon lectures.
examples.zh: 我通常午饭后「小睡」二十分钟，好撑过下午的课。

examples.en: She napped on the couch while her laundry ran in the basement.
examples.zh: 她在沙发上「打了个盹」，衣服正在地下室洗着。

words.enDefinition: fall into light sleep without meaning to

examples.en: I keep dozing off in the warm back rows of the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 阶梯教室后排暖和，我总在那儿「打瞌睡」。

examples.en: He dozed off on the train and rode two stops past his station.
examples.zh: 他在火车上「打起了瞌睡」，坐过了两站才醒。

words.enDefinition: take off one set of clothes and wear another

examples.en: Give me a minute to change into something warmer before we walk over.
examples.zh: 等我一分钟，我「换」件暖和点的衣服再走过去。

examples.en: She changed into gym clothes right after her last seminar.
examples.zh: 最后一节研讨课一结束，她就「换上」了运动服。

words.enDefinition: rub something hard with a brush to clean it

examples.en: I scrubbed the burnt pot for half an hour after Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 周日晚饭后，我把糊了的锅「刷洗」了半个小时。

examples.en: You'll need to scrub the shower tiles; wiping won't remove that mold.
examples.zh: 淋浴间的瓷砖得用力「刷」，擦是擦不掉那些霉斑的。

words.enDefinition: wash something quickly with clean water

examples.en: Please rinse the plates before you load them into the dishwasher.
examples.zh: 放洗碗机之前，请先把盘子「冲洗」一下。

examples.en: I rinsed the spinach three times to get rid of the sand.
examples.zh: 我把菠菜「冲洗」了三遍，去掉里面的沙子。

words.enDefinition: leave something in liquid to soften or clean it

examples.en: Soak the stained shirt in cold water before you wash it.
examples.zh: 洗之前先把有污渍的衬衫「泡」在冷水里。

examples.en: I left the rice soaking while I went to my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 我去上早课的时候，米饭一直「泡」在水里。

words.enDefinition: put your things into bags before leaving

examples.en: We packed up the picnic things as soon as the drizzle started.
examples.zh: 毛毛雨一下起来，我们就把野餐的东西「打包」了。

examples.en: It's almost closing time, so start packing up your laptop and notes.
examples.zh: 快到闭馆时间了，开始把电脑和笔记「收」起来吧。

words.enDefinition: take your things out of bags after arriving

examples.en: I'll unpack my suitcase tomorrow; tonight I'm too jet-lagged to do anything.
examples.zh: 行李箱我明天再「拆」，今晚时差太重，什么都不想干。

examples.en: She unpacked her boxes and hung the curtains on her first day.
examples.zh: 搬来的第一天她就「拆箱整理」，还挂好了窗帘。

words.enDefinition: finish the last part of an activity or meeting

examples.en: Let's wrap up the group call—it's almost the dorm's quiet hours.
examples.zh: 小组通话就到这里「收尾」吧，快到宿舍安静时段了。

examples.en: The presenter wrapped up five minutes early and left time for questions.
examples.zh: 汇报人提前五分钟「收尾」，留出了提问时间。

words.enDefinition: arrange things in a neat pile

examples.en: Stack the clean dishes on the drying rack instead of putting them away wet.
examples.zh: 洗好的碗先「摞」在沥水架上，别湿着放回橱柜。

examples.en: She stacked her borrowed library books neatly by the door.
examples.zh: 她把借来的图书馆的书整齐地「码」在门边。

words.enDefinition: separate things into groups by type

examples.en: Sort your recycling into the right bins, or the whole building gets fined.
examples.zh: 回收垃圾要「分类」投进对应的桶，不然整栋楼会被罚款。

examples.en: I sorted my emails into folders so scholarship deadlines wouldn't get buried.
examples.zh: 我把邮件「归类」到不同文件夹，免得奖学金的截止日期被淹没。

words.enDefinition: remove things you do not need to make space tidier

examples.en: We decluttered the shared closet and donated three bags to the thrift store.
examples.zh: 我们「清理」了公用的衣橱，捐了三袋东西给旧货店。

examples.en: Declutter your desk before finals—a clear space really helps you focus.
examples.zh: 期末前把书桌「收拾清爽」，整洁的环境确实有助于专注。

words.enDefinition: open windows to let fresh air move through

examples.en: Air out the dorm room every morning—it always smells like instant noodles.
examples.zh: 每天早上给宿舍「通通风」，总有一股泡面味。

examples.en: He aired out the stuffy kitchen after frying fish last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚煎完鱼，他把满是味道的厨房「通」了会儿风。

words.enDefinition: carry something from inside a building to outside

examples.en: It's your turn to take out the trash; the bag is already tied.
examples.zh: 轮到你「倒」垃圾了，垃圾袋已经系好了。

examples.en: I take out the recycling every Tuesday before my nine o'clock lecture.
examples.zh: 每周二九点的课前，我都会把回收物「拿出去」。

words.enDefinition: wash and dry a load of dirty clothes

examples.en: I do laundry on Thursday nights when the basement machines are free.
examples.zh: 我周四晚上「洗衣服」，那时地下室的洗衣机没人用。

examples.en: Do your laundry before the trip, or you'll pack a pile of dirty clothes.
examples.zh: 出发前把衣服「洗」了，不然你打包的全是脏衣服。

words.enDefinition: give plants liquid so they keep growing well

examples.en: Could you water my basil while I'm home for spring break?
examples.zh: 我回家过春假期间，能帮我给罗勒「浇水」吗？

examples.en: He watered the succulents too often and they started to rot.
examples.zh: 他给多肉「浇水」太勤，多肉都开始烂了。

words.enDefinition: look after children while their parents are away

examples.en: She babysits for our neighbor every Friday to cover her phone bill.
examples.zh: 她每周五帮邻居「照看小孩」，赚点手机话费。

examples.en: I can't come to movie night—I'm babysitting my cousin's twins tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚电影之夜去不了了，我要帮表哥「带」双胞胎。

words.enDefinition: lock all the doors before leaving a place

examples.en: Lock up before you leave for winter break—windows too, not just the door.
examples.zh: 寒假出门前把屋子「锁好」，不光是门，窗户也要锁。

examples.en: The last person to leave the studio has to lock up.
examples.zh: 最后一个离开工作室的人要负责「锁门」。

words.enDefinition: give one thing and receive another in return

examples.en: Want to swap shifts? I'll take your Tuesday if you cover my Friday.
examples.zh: 要不要「换」班？你替我周五，我替你周二。

examples.en: We swapped our textbooks instead of each buying a secondhand copy.
examples.zh: 我们没有各自买二手书，而是把课本「交换」着用。

words.enDefinition: give things or money to help others

examples.en: Donate your old winter coat to the collection box in the lobby.
examples.zh: 把旧冬衣「捐」到大厅的募捐箱吧。

examples.en: We donated our extra furniture to the incoming exchange students.
examples.zh: 我们把多余的家具「捐」给了新来的交换生。

words.enDefinition: put used glass, paper, or plastic out for reuse

examples.en: Recycle the cardboard boxes right away; they block the whole hallway otherwise.
examples.zh: 纸箱要及时「回收」，不然会把整条走廊都堵住。

examples.en: Our dorm recycles batteries at the front desk every month.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼每个月在前台「回收」电池。

words.zhGloss: 用发卡把头发别到后面
words.enDefinition: Secure hair away from the face using a pin or clip.
acceptedZhAnswers: 用发卡把头发别到后面

examples.en: I usually pin back my hair before kneading dough at the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 我在餐桌上揉面前，通常会「用发卡把头发别到后面」。

examples.en: She had to pin back her fringe before trying on the new glasses.
examples.zh: 她得先「用发卡把刘海别到后面」，再试戴新眼镜。

words.enDefinition: arrange a seat, table, or room in advance

examples.en: Book the group study room early during finals week—it fills up fast.
examples.zh: 期末周要早点「预订」小组研讨室，很快就会被订满。

examples.en: I booked a table for six at the Korean place near campus.
examples.zh: 我在校园附近那家韩餐馆「订」了六个位子。

words.enDefinition: block a pipe or drain so nothing can pass

examples.en: Pouring oil down the sink will clog the drain eventually.
examples.zh: 把油倒进水池，下水道早晚会「堵」。

examples.en: The shower drain clogged with hair again, so water pooled around our feet.
examples.zh: 淋浴间的下水口又被头发「堵」住了，水积在我们脚边。

words.enDefinition: flow over the edges because there is too much

examples.en: Leave the sink running and it will overflow onto the floor.
examples.zh: 水池的水龙头不关，水会「溢出」流到地板上。

examples.en: The trash can overflowed because pickup was delayed by the holiday.
examples.zh: 垃圾清运因假期推迟，垃圾桶都「满得溢出来」了。

words.enDefinition: fall in small drops of liquid

examples.en: The faucet keeps dripping at night, and I can hear it through the wall.
examples.zh: 水龙头夜里一直「滴水」，隔着墙都能听见。

examples.en: His wet umbrella dripped all over the shared hallway floor.
examples.zh: 他的湿伞把公共走廊的地板「滴」得到处都是水。

words.enDefinition: do something wrongly or make a place untidy

examples.en: I messed up the booking and reserved two rooms instead of one.
examples.zh: 我「搞砸」了预订，订成了两间房而不是一间。

examples.en: Don't mess up the labeled folders—everything is sorted by deadline.
examples.zh: 别把贴好标签的文件夹「弄乱」，所有文件都是按截止日期排好的。

words.enDefinition: gather into a growing stack over time

examples.en: The dirty mugs keep piling up next to the sink in our flat.
examples.zh: 我们公寓水槽边的脏杯子越「堆」越多。

examples.en: Unread emails pile up fast during midterms, so check them daily.
examples.zh: 期中期间未读邮件「堆积」得飞快，最好每天查看。

words.enDefinition: find someone or something after a difficult search

examples.en: It took me a week to track down the lost package slip.
examples.zh: 我花了一周才「找到」那张丢失的包裹单。

examples.en: I finally tracked down the owner of the umbrella left in the lab.
examples.zh: 我终于「找到」了那把落在实验室的雨伞的主人。

words.enDefinition: make frozen food soft and ready to cook

examples.en: Defrost the chicken in the fridge overnight, not on the counter.
examples.zh: 鸡肉要提前一晚放冰箱「解冻」，别放在台面上。

examples.en: I forgot to defrost the dumplings, so dinner is running late.
examples.zh: 我忘了给饺子「解冻」，晚饭要推迟了。

words.enDefinition: heat food quickly using the kitchen appliance

examples.en: Just microwave the rice for a minute and it will taste fine.
examples.zh: 米饭用微波炉「热」一分钟就很好吃了。

examples.en: Never microwave that takeout box; the foil lining will spark inside.
examples.zh: 千万别把那个外卖盒放进「微波炉」加热，内衬锡纸会打火。

words.enDefinition: make tea or coffee with hot water

examples.en: I brew a pot of jasmine tea every evening while I review notes.
examples.zh: 我每天晚上复习时都会「泡」一壶茉莉花茶。

examples.en: She brewed a fresh pot of coffee before our three-hour library session.
examples.zh: 去图书馆自习三小时之前，她「冲」了一壶新咖啡。

words.enDefinition: drink slowly, taking very small amounts

examples.en: I sipped my latte slowly while skimming the morning news.
examples.zh: 我一边浏览早间新闻，一边「小口喝」拿铁。

examples.en: Sip water during the seminar instead of gulping it all at once.
examples.zh: 研讨课上要「小口喝水」，别一口气猛灌。

words.enDefinition: put your name on a list to join something

examples.en: Sign up for the free gym orientation before the semester gets busy.
examples.zh: 趁学期还没忙起来，早点「报名」免费的健身房入门课。

examples.en: Have you signed up for the campus volunteering fair yet?
examples.zh: 校园志愿者招聘会你「报名」了吗？

words.enDefinition: give one copy of something to each person

examples.en: The TA handed out practice questions before the midterm review.
examples.zh: 期中复习前，助教「分发」了练习题。

examples.en: Volunteers will hand out free water bottles at the registration desk.
examples.zh: 志愿者会在签到处「发放」免费的瓶装水。

words.enDefinition: decide not to do something you normally do

examples.en: I skipped breakfast again because the dining hall line was too long.
examples.zh: 食堂队伍太长，我又「省掉」了早餐。

examples.en: Never skip the safety briefing before your first lab session.
examples.zh: 第一次进实验室之前，千万别「跳过」安全讲解。

words.enDefinition: try to find out the facts about a problem

examples.en: I'll look into why our heating bill doubled this month.
examples.zh: 我会去「查一查」为什么这个月暖气费翻倍。

examples.en: The housing office promised to look into the noise complaints.
examples.zh: 住房办公室答应「调查」噪音投诉的问题。

words.enDefinition: turn pages quickly without reading carefully

examples.en: I flipped through the guidebook to find the cheapest hostel option.
examples.zh: 我「翻」了一遍旅行指南，找最便宜的青旅。

examples.en: She flipped through her notes one last time before the quiz.
examples.zh: 小测前她把笔记最后「翻看」了一遍。

words.enDefinition: Cut a small part off something with scissors or a similar tool.

examples.en: Use the small scissors to snip off the loose thread before it catches on something.
examples.zh: 用小剪刀把那根松线头「剪掉」，免得挂到东西。

examples.en: I had to snip off a corner of the bag to pour out the seeds.
examples.zh: 我得「剪掉」袋角的一小截，才能把种子倒出来。

words.enDefinition: write something quickly so you remember it

examples.en: Note down the professor's office hours before you leave the hall.
examples.zh: 离开教室前，把教授的办公时间「记下来」。

examples.en: I noted down the Wi-Fi password as soon as she said it.
examples.zh: 她一说Wi-Fi密码，我就「记」了下来。

words.enDefinition: write a few words quickly and briefly

examples.en: Jot down the locker number so you don't forget it tonight.
examples.zh: 把储物柜编号「记一下」，免得晚上忘了。

examples.en: She jotted down a grocery list on the back of her ticket.
examples.zh: 她在票的背面「匆匆写下」购物清单。

words.enDefinition: remove writing or recorded data completely

examples.en: Erase the whiteboard before the next seminar group comes in.
examples.zh: 下一组研讨课进来之前，把白板「擦」干净。

examples.en: I accidentally erased my whole draft instead of saving a copy.
examples.zh: 我一不小心把整个草稿「删」了，都没存副本。

words.enDefinition: check something a second time to be certain

examples.en: Double-check the locker code before you leave the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 离开游泳馆前，再「核对」一遍储物柜密码。

examples.en: I double-checked the train times because the app had crashed twice.
examples.zh: App崩了两次，我又「确认」了一遍火车时刻。

words.enDefinition: arrive at a place or event as expected

examples.en: Only four people showed up to the first floor meeting of the term.
examples.zh: 本学期第一次楼层会议只有四个人「到场」。

examples.en: He showed up twenty minutes late with a coffee in each hand.
examples.zh: 他两手各拿一杯咖啡才「露面」，迟到了二十分钟。

words.enDefinition: stand in a row waiting for your turn

examples.en: Students lined up outside the registrar's office before it even opened.
examples.zh: 教务处还没开门，学生们就在外面「排队」了。

examples.en: Line up at the second window for graduation gown pickup.
examples.zh: 取毕业礼服请在二号窗口「排队」。

words.enDefinition: copy a file from the internet onto your device

examples.en: Download the campus map app before orientation day so you don't get lost.
examples.zh: 迎新日前先「下载」校园地图App，免得迷路。

examples.en: I downloaded the lecture slides to read offline on the bus.
examples.zh: 我把课件「下载」下来，好在公交车上离线看。

words.enDefinition: send a file from your device to a website

examples.en: Upload your essay to the portal before eleven tonight—no extensions.
examples.zh: 今晚十一点前把论文「上传」到系统，不能延期。

examples.en: The portal crashed while I was uploading my group presentation.
examples.zh: 我「上传」小组展示文件的时候，系统崩了。

words.enDefinition: enter your password to start using a system

examples.en: Log in with your student ID to access the library databases.
examples.zh: 用你的学号「登录」，就能使用图书馆数据库。

examples.en: I couldn't log in because the portal was down all morning.
examples.zh: 教务系统整个上午都宕机，我一直「登录」不上。

words.enDefinition: close your account session on a computer

examples.en: Always log out of the library computers when your session ends.
examples.zh: 在图书馆的电脑上用完，一定要「退出登录」。

examples.en: He forgot to log out, and the next user saw all his files.
examples.zh: 他忘了「退出登录」，下一位用户能看到他所有的文件。

words.enDefinition: move content up or down on a screen

examples.en: I scrolled through the group chat to find the room booking link.
examples.zh: 我在群聊里来回「翻找」，想找到订房链接。

examples.en: Scroll down to the bottom of the page and click agree.
examples.zh: 把页面往下「滑动」到底，然后点击同意。

words.enDefinition: move a finger quickly across a screen or card reader

examples.en: Swipe left to see more photos of the dorm room.
examples.zh: 往左「滑动」可以看更多宿舍房间的照片。

examples.en: Just swipe your student card at the gate and walk through.
examples.zh: 在大门口「刷」一下学生卡就能进去。

words.enDefinition: look through websites or shops without a fixed plan

examples.en: I spent the whole break browsing secondhand bike listings online.
examples.zh: 整个假期我都在网上「浏览」二手自行车信息。

examples.en: Browse the course catalog for a while before your advising appointment.
examples.zh: 导师见面之前，先花点时间「浏览」一下课程目录。

words.enDefinition: make part of a screen image look bigger

examples.en: Zoom in on the timetable—my eyes can't read the tiny print.
examples.zh: 把课表「放大」，这字太小，我眼睛看不清。

examples.en: I zoomed in on the map until I could see the dorm entrance.
examples.zh: 我把地图「放大」，直到看清宿舍入口。

words.enDefinition: Press an absorbent material against spilled liquid to soak it up.

examples.en: I used an old towel to blot a spill on the rug before it spread.
examples.zh: 趁液体还没洇开，我用一条旧毛巾「吸去地毯上洒出的液体」。

examples.en: Keep a clean cloth nearby so you can blot a spill without rubbing the fabric.
examples.zh: 手边放块干净的布，方便你「吸去洒出的液体」，省得搓揉布料。

collocations: blot a spill with a towel

words.enDefinition: save a web address so you can find it quickly

examples.en: Bookmark the bus tracker page so you can find it each morning.
examples.zh: 把公交实时查询页面「收藏」起来，每天早上都要用。

examples.en: I bookmarked twenty recipes and cooked exactly none of them.
examples.zh: 我「收藏」了二十个菜谱，结果一个都没做过。

words.enDefinition: put copied text or images into a new place

examples.en: Copy the meeting link and paste it into the group chat.
examples.zh: 复制会议链接，然后「粘贴」到群聊里。

examples.en: I accidentally pasted the wrong paragraph into my application essay.
examples.zh: 我一不小心把错误的段落「粘贴」进了申请文书。

words.enDefinition: make a digital copy with a machine or phone camera

examples.en: Scan the QR code at the library entrance instead of showing your card.
examples.zh: 在图书馆入口「扫」二维码就行，不用出示学生卡。

examples.en: I scanned my passport and emailed the copy to the housing office.
examples.zh: 我把护照「扫描」了一份，用邮件发给了住房办公室。

words.enDefinition: save a second copy of files in case of loss

examples.en: Back up your thesis to the cloud before you update your laptop.
examples.zh: 升级笔记本系统之前，先把论文「备份」到云端。

examples.en: She lost two essays because she never backed up her files.
examples.zh: 她因为从不「备份」文件，弄丢了两篇论文。

words.enDefinition: make the same data appear on all your devices

examples.en: Sync your calendar so the group schedule shows on your phone too.
examples.zh: 把日历「同步」一下，小组日程在手机上也能看。

examples.en: My notes didn't sync between my laptop and my tablet last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我的笔记在笔记本和平板之间没「同步」成功。

words.enDefinition: turn off the sound of a device or meeting

examples.en: Mute your microphone in the online class when you are not talking.
examples.zh: 上网课时没发言，就把麦克风「静音」。

examples.en: I muted the group chat during finals week to concentrate.
examples.zh: 期末周为了专心，我把群聊「静音」了。

words.enDefinition: turn the microphone or sound back on

examples.en: Remember to unmute yourself before you start presenting your part.
examples.zh: 轮到你展示之前，记得「取消静音」。

examples.en: The professor asked me to unmute because nobody could hear my answer.
examples.zh: 教授让我「打开麦克风」，因为没人能听到我的回答。

words.enDefinition: lose or end a device's link to a network

examples.en: The dorm Wi-Fi disconnects every night at two for maintenance.
examples.zh: 宿舍Wi-Fi每晚两点会「断开」进行维护。

examples.en: My Bluetooth headphones keep disconnecting in the middle of online seminars.
examples.zh: 上网课时，我的蓝牙耳机总是「断连」。

words.enDefinition: turn a device off and on again to fix it

examples.en: Restart the router first; that quick fix solves most dorm Wi-Fi problems.
examples.zh: 先「重启」路由器，这个小操作能解决宿舍Wi-Fi的大部分问题。

examples.en: The technician told me to restart my laptop before calling again.
examples.zh: 技术员让我先「重启」笔记本，然后再打电话。

words.enDefinition: close everything and turn a computer off

examples.en: Shut down your laptop properly; closing the lid isn't the same.
examples.zh: 要正确「关机」，直接合上盖子可不算。

examples.en: The lab computers shut down automatically at ten every night.
examples.zh: 机房电脑每晚十点「自动关机」。

words.enDefinition: remove a device's connection to the electricity supply

examples.en: Unplug the heater when you leave the room—it's a fire risk.
examples.zh: 离开房间要「拔掉」暖气的插头，有火灾隐患。

examples.en: I unplugged everything before leaving for the week-long trip home.
examples.zh: 回家一周前，我把所有电器插头都「拔」了。

words.enDefinition: find the cause of a problem by testing step by step

examples.en: It took us an hour to troubleshoot the printer before we called IT.
examples.zh: 我们「排查」了一个小时打印机的问题，才叫IT支持。

examples.en: The IT desk taught me to troubleshoot Wi-Fi issues on my own.
examples.zh: IT服务台教了我自己「排查」Wi-Fi问题的方法。

words.enDefinition: contact someone again to check on progress

examples.en: I emailed the landlord on Monday and followed up with a call on Wednesday.
examples.zh: 我周一给房东发了邮件，周三又打电话「跟进」。

examples.en: Please follow up on the maintenance request; it's been a week.
examples.zh: 维修申请请「跟进」一下，已经过去一周了。

words.enDefinition: travel regularly between home and campus or work

examples.en: I commute by regional train for forty minutes twice a week.
examples.zh: 我每周两次坐区间火车「通勤」四十分钟。

examples.en: She commutes from the suburbs because on-campus housing is expensive.
examples.zh: 校内住宿太贵，她从郊区「通勤」上学。

words.enDefinition: share a car ride with people going the same way

examples.en: Four of us carpool to the satellite campus every Tuesday and Thursday.
examples.zh: 我们四个人每周二、四「拼车」去分校区。

examples.en: Carpooling with classmates saves us almost thirty dollars a week on gas.
examples.zh: 和同学「拼车」，每周能省下将近三十美元的油费。

words.enDefinition: not know where you are in an unfamiliar place

examples.en: I got lost on my first day and ended up at the wrong campus.
examples.zh: 开学第一天我就「迷路」了，走到了别的校区。

examples.en: Download the offline map so you don't get lost in the old town.
examples.zh: 下载离线地图，免得在老城区「迷路」。

words.enDefinition: to put things into a bag or container again, often in a different arrangement

examples.en: I had to repack my bag after remembering the shoes for tomorrow's practice.
examples.zh: 想起明天训练还要带鞋后，我只好「重新打包」。

examples.en: We needed to repack the boxes after one of them split at the bottom.
examples.zh: 有个纸箱底部裂了，我们需要「重新打包」。

words.enDefinition: to open a container or envelope by removing or breaking its seal

examples.en: I waited until my roommate arrived before I tried to unseal the parcel.
examples.zh: 我等室友来了才把包裹「拆封」。

examples.en: We had to unseal the envelope to check which form was inside.
examples.zh: 我们得把信封「拆开」，看看里面是哪张表。

words.enDefinition: to close a package or container so that its opening is sealed again

examples.en: I used the plastic strip to reseal the bag after pouring out the oats.
examples.zh: 倒出燕麦后，我用塑料封条把袋子「重新封好」。

examples.en: I forgot to reseal the packet before putting it back in the cupboard.
examples.zh: 我忘了先把袋子「重新封好」，就放回了柜子。

words.enDefinition: to undo a knot or release something held by tied string or rope

examples.en: I stopped to untie my shoelaces before trying on the boots in the shop.
examples.zh: 在店里试靴子之前，我先把鞋带「解开」。

examples.en: My flatmate helped me untie the cord around the folded camping mat.
examples.zh: 室友帮我把折叠露营垫外面的绳结「解开」。

words.enDefinition: to mark a box with words that identify its contents, owner or destination

examples.en: I used a thick marker to label a box with my room number.
examples.zh: 我用粗头记号笔「给箱子贴标签」，写上了房间号。

examples.en: You can label a box before filling it if the contents are already planned.
examples.zh: 如果已经知道要装什么，可以先「给箱子贴标签」再装。

collocations: label a box with your name

words.enDefinition: to remove a substance from a surface by washing it

examples.en: I went back inside to wash off the mud on my hands.
examples.zh: 我回屋把手上的泥「用水洗掉」。

examples.en: I used cold water to wash off the paint on the desk.
examples.zh: 我用凉水把书桌上的颜料「洗掉」。

words.enDefinition: to touch something lightly with a cloth or sponge, often repeatedly

examples.en: My flatmate told me to dab the stain with a clean cloth.
examples.zh: 室友叫我用干净的布「轻轻点拭」那块污渍。

examples.en: I used a paper towel to dab the water around the bowl.
examples.zh: 我用纸巾「轻轻点拭」碗周围的水。

words.enDefinition: to remove something by moving a cloth, tissue or hand over it

examples.en: I used my sleeve to wipe away the mist on the bus window.
examples.zh: 我用袖子「擦掉」公交车玻璃上的雾气。

examples.en: I stopped to wipe away the spilled tea before opening my notebook.
examples.zh: 打开笔记本之前，我先「擦掉」洒出来的茶。

words.enDefinition: to remove dirt or a mark by wiping with a damp sponge

examples.en: I tried to sponge off the muddy marks before they dried on the bag.
examples.zh: 泥印还没干在包上，我就试着「用海绵擦掉」。

examples.en: My roommate helped me sponge off the dust left on the plastic chairs.
examples.zh: 室友帮我「用海绵擦掉」塑料椅上留下的灰。

collocations: use water to sponge off the residue

words.enDefinition: to remove dust from an object, often with a cloth or brush

examples.en: I had to dust off my bicycle before taking it out after winter.
examples.zh: 过完冬天，我得先给自行车「掸去灰尘」再骑出去。

examples.en: We took a moment to dust off the folding chairs before guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人来之前，我们先给折叠椅「掸去灰尘」。

collocations: take a moment to dust off a chair

words.enDefinition: to fold something again, often to change its size or shape

examples.en: I had to refold the map because it would not fit in my pocket.
examples.zh: 地图塞不进口袋，所以我得「重新折叠」。

examples.en: My flatmate helped me refold the blanket so it fit on the shelf.
examples.zh: 室友帮我把毯子「重新折叠」，好放上架。

words.enDefinition: to wash something manually instead of using a washing machine or dishwasher

examples.en: The sweater label said to wash by hand and lay it flat.
examples.zh: 毛衣标签要求「用手洗」，然后平放晾干。

examples.en: I chose to wash by hand because the shared machine was already running.
examples.zh: 共用洗衣机已经在用了，我决定「用手洗」。

collocations: wash by hand in cool water

words.enDefinition: to reverse clothes so that their inner surface becomes their outer surface

examples.en: The laundry guide says to turn clothes inside out if they have printed designs.
examples.zh: 洗衣指南说，衣物有印花时要「把衣物翻到里面朝外」。

examples.en: My roommate showed me how to turn clothes inside out before putting them in the wash.
examples.zh: 室友教我怎样在洗涤前「把衣物翻到里面朝外」。

collocations: turn clothes inside out before washing
turn clothes inside out to protect a print
turn clothes inside out to check the seams

words.enDefinition: to separate things that are twisted or caught around one another

examples.en: I stopped to untangle my earphones before the recording started in the lecture.
examples.zh: 课堂录音开始前，我停下来「解开」缠在一起的耳机线。

examples.en: We needed to untangle the straps before carrying the bags down to reception.
examples.zh: 我们得先「解开」缠在一起的背带，再把包拿到前台。

words.enDefinition: to change the positions or order of a group of things

examples.en: We wanted to rearrange the chairs so we could all see the screen.
examples.zh: 我们想「重新摆放」椅子，让所有人都看得到屏幕。

examples.en: I helped rearrange the books after we cleared some space on the shelf.
examples.zh: 我们在架子上腾出空间后，我帮忙把书「重新摆放」。

collocations: rearrange the chairs in a circle

words.enDefinition: to put something back into a pile or make a new pile from it

examples.en: I had to restack the papers after they slid off the desk.
examples.zh: 纸张从书桌上滑下去后，我只好「重新叠放」。

examples.en: My classmate helped me restack the trays beside the café counter.
examples.zh: 同学帮我把托盘在咖啡馆柜台旁「重新叠放」好。

words.enDefinition: to draw a line underneath a word or passage to mark it

examples.en: I used a pencil to underline the dates I needed for revision.
examples.zh: 我用铅笔在复习要用的日期「下面划线」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to underline the phrase that supported each answer.
examples.zh: 导师请我们在能支持各个答案的短语「下面划线」。

words.enDefinition: to read something that you have already read one more time

examples.en: I had to reread the message because I missed the last sentence.
examples.zh: 我漏看了最后一句，所以得把消息「再读一遍」。

examples.en: I took a minute to reread the instructions before opening the form.
examples.zh: 打开表格之前，我花了一分钟把说明「再读一遍」。

words.enDefinition: to move playback backward so an earlier part can be played again

examples.en: Could you rewind a little so I can hear what the speaker said?
examples.zh: 你能「把播放进度往回倒」一点吗？我想听清讲者说了什么。

examples.en: I tried to rewind the recording to find the instructions for the assignment.
examples.zh: 我试着「把播放进度往回倒」，找作业说明。

words.enDefinition: to question whether a decision or judgment you already made was right

examples.en: I started to second-guess my choice when I saw the crowded timetable.
examples.zh: 看到满满的时间表，我开始「怀疑原来的判断」。

examples.en: My friend told me not to second-guess every answer after the quiz.
examples.zh: 朋友劝我测验结束后，别再「反复怀疑」各道题的答案。

collocations: try not to second-guess a choice

words.enDefinition: to read something quickly to get the main idea or find selected information

examples.en: I had time to skim through the leaflet before my study group arrived.
examples.zh: 学习小组成员到之前，我有时间「快速浏览」宣传单。

examples.en: I stopped to skim through the instructions before picking up the form.
examples.zh: 拿表格前，我停下来「快速浏览」了一下说明。

words.enDefinition: to look quickly or discreetly inside a place or object

examples.en: I opened the box just enough to peek inside before carrying it upstairs.
examples.zh: 我把箱子开了一条缝，「往里面偷看一眼」后才搬上楼。

examples.en: We stopped to peek inside the empty hall while the caretaker unlocked it.
examples.zh: 管理员给空大厅开锁时，我们停下「往里面偷看一眼」。

collocations: take a moment to peek inside

words.enDefinition: to look for private information about someone without their permission

examples.en: I told my flatmate that I would never snoop through their messages.
examples.zh: 我告诉室友，我绝不会翻他们的消息来「窥探私事」。

examples.en: The film was about a student who liked to snoop around the office.
examples.zh: 电影讲的是一个喜欢在办公室周围「窥探别人私事」的学生。

words.enDefinition: to direct your eyes at something briefly without carefully studying it

examples.en: I stopped to glance at the poster while walking to my afternoon class.
examples.zh: 去上下午课的路上，我停下「匆匆看了一眼」海报。

examples.en: I had a moment to glance at the weather before heading out.
examples.zh: 出门前我有一点时间「匆匆看了一眼」天气。

words.enDefinition: to do someone's work temporarily while they are absent or unavailable

examples.en: I agreed to fill in for a classmate at the library desk.
examples.zh: 我同意「暂时代替」一位同学在图书馆柜台上班。

examples.en: The club asked me to fill in for the person running the meeting.
examples.zh: 社团请我「暂时代替」原定主持会议的人。

collocations: ask someone to fill in for you
fill in for the regular host

words.enDefinition: to take someone or something with you when you go to a place

examples.en: You can bring along a notebook if you want to record your ideas.
examples.zh: 你想记下想法的话，可以「随身带来」一本笔记本。

examples.en: The group asked us to bring along a jacket for the walk home.
examples.zh: 小组让我们「随身带来」一件夹克，走路回家时穿。

collocations: remember to bring along a jacket

words.enDefinition: to accompany people who already have plans to go somewhere

examples.en: I asked if I could tag along when my roommates went shopping.
examples.zh: 室友们去购物时，我问能不能「跟着一起去」。

examples.en: We told our classmate she could tag along on the walk home.
examples.zh: 我们告诉同学，步行回家时她可以「跟着一起去」。

words.enDefinition: to keep something in your possession instead of giving it away or discarding it

examples.en: I decided to hold on to the receipt until the replacement arrived.
examples.zh: 我决定「留着」收据，等替换商品到了再说。

examples.en: We asked everyone to hold on to their tickets until the end.
examples.zh: 我们请大家把票「留着不丢」，一直留到结束。

collocations: hold on to something for later

words.enDefinition: to manage with something that is not ideal because better options are unavailable

examples.en: We had to make do with two chairs for the whole study group.
examples.zh: 整个学习小组只能拿两把椅子「将就着用」。

examples.en: I agreed to make do with the smaller bag for a day.
examples.zh: 我同意先拿那个小一点的包「将就着用」一天。

collocations: make do with what you have

words.enDefinition: to collect things scattered or spread out in one place

examples.en: I stopped to gather up the papers before the hall doors closed.
examples.zh: 大厅门关上前，我停下来「把散落的纸收拢」。

examples.en: We asked the students to gather up their belongings before leaving the room.
examples.zh: 我们请同学离开房间前「把自己的东西收拢」带走。

words.enDefinition: to look through a group of things carefully to find, check or organize them

examples.en: I had to sort through three folders before finding the lecturer's handout.
examples.zh: 找到讲师的讲义前，我得在三个文件夹里「逐一翻找筛选」。

examples.en: We spent the morning trying to sort through the boxes from our move.
examples.zh: 我们上午试着在搬家带来的那些箱子里「逐一翻找筛选」。

collocations: help someone sort through the boxes
